title: Fugue in A minor

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in the alto, on A.
☞ The answer in the soprano, on E.
☞ The bass enters with the subject, on A.
☞ The tenor answers last, on E: all four voices are in.
☞ The soprano turns the subject upside down, from E.
☞ Stretto: the soprano on A, then the tenor two beats later.
☞ Stretto on C: the soprano, then the bass two beats later.
☞ The subject in the soprano, on A, as the texture grows to five voices.
☞ The tenor inverts the subject over the bass's held A.
☞ Stretto: after the tenor, the fifth voice on D, then the soprano on A.

listenFor: 4 voices, five at the close; the subject upright and inverted, in stretto
